Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 17, "heading": "CHAPTER 15. I MAKE ANOTHER BEGINNING", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u017-b0030", "target": "— Это мой племянник, — сказала тётушка.", "source_sha256": "ab992bc42c05a85ac38b485362d8585513427cabd9d08a41a0dfa6bea3841377", "target_id": "ru-en85-u017-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ce8a1a91e252e1182d10109b4d27c9968c2f28070f3d65e7aaa80d8f4f2301c5"}, {"source_id": "en85-u017-b0031", "target": "— Не знал, что он у вас есть, мисс Тротвуд, — сказал мистер Уикфилд.", "source_sha256": "e9eb674c6f36493d5fc61d011685f9286ada21f36514bc8078f66f1973ba1911", "target_id": "ru-en85-u017-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "550f595c9c3ec4cb750ac59424ee3b632c60d40d10356daf9bfd8166a4399d86"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 15, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u017-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My grand-nephew, that is to say,’ observed my aunt.", "sha256": "f5a83d164a17497501ab7a012be3fe7aff1fb9980f7b499982431160900c0425", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Wasn’t aware you had a grand-nephew, I give you my word,’ said Mr. Wickfield.", "sha256": "0bca8a073b1965b2e27cb758ad62147c7c40e621163b08ee8ff3094b347e67a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have adopted him,’ said my aunt, with a wave of her hand, importing that his knowledge and his ignorance were all one to her, ‘and I have brought him here, to put to a school where he may be thoroughly well taught, and well treated. Now tell me where that school is, and what it is, and all about it.’", "sha256": "b4d624737f72150d95adbeb69c9c2fa6e65388ffab7584d6a5ecbcb13a0acb91", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Before I can advise you properly,’ said Mr. Wickfield—‘the old question, you know. What’s your motive in this?’", "sha256": "e26111bb1a6ef4e42f37b8329f01fa0962db84d47d1c399a982f6dde5e5fe16b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Deuce take the man!’ exclaimed my aunt. ‘Always fishing for motives, when they’re on the surface! Why, to make the child happy and useful.’", "sha256": "4cfe9489f2c1afdd9aff24ae6c2986d293d57a58a28e86340b70f06811d07850", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It must be a mixed motive, I think,’ said Mr. Wickfield, shaking his head and smiling incredulously.", "sha256": "6b58d258bf5422f4941411f12018217a9e4b4d0474e3637ab45323b9443b9a78", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A mixed fiddlestick,’ returned my aunt. ‘You claim to have one plain motive in all you do yourself. You don’t suppose, I hope, that you are the only plain dealer in the world?’", "sha256": "a64ed17a445ec2347f75cabf976e8f157d52dd3962e5442f1c9bd0662d2be0b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ay, but I have only one motive in life, Miss Trotwood,’ he rejoined, smiling. ‘Other people have dozens, scores, hundreds. I have only one. There’s the difference. However, that’s beside the question. The best school? Whatever the motive, you want the best?’", "sha256": "9e3f549a602c8ab901ed0fab4b7ea1e8e13550038b575ef40203556dee21c9d4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt nodded assent.", "sha256": "d42a9cd2ee151244d5a8c3bed3bc242e281cb013bf1acf583bda4f3e79462972", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘At the best we have,’ said Mr. Wickfield, considering, ‘your nephew couldn’t board just now.’", "sha256": "5622d1d5ab18bc54ef39e00852cfe64356ab5160dbf890c6af73383bc9fb73ff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But he could board somewhere else, I suppose?’ suggested my aunt.", "sha256": "2224e7c19861a22541cf57727cb6779bbfb8ab43989b1fcbfa5476c3d4d6b9e1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Wickfield thought I could. After a little discussion, he proposed to take my aunt to the school, that she might see it and judge for herself; also, to take her, with the same object, to two or three houses where he thought I could be boarded. My aunt embracing the proposal, we were all three going out together, when he stopped and said:", "sha256": "c6ca0dd4ec666bcef08c14193c6a916f2591b6cb309583ad67c4fed82befee81", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Our little friend here might have some motive, perhaps, for objecting to the arrangements. I think we had better leave him behind?’", "sha256": "bb3587d109c6261d9cd84bf1557b74633122bd609310be5bcde570c7d5675cfe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt seemed disposed to contest the point; but to facilitate matters I said I would gladly remain behind, if they pleased; and returned into Mr. Wickfield’s office, where I sat down again, in the chair I had first occupied, to await their return.", "sha256": "d7e55fbc545af3235df5136fd5b2d979519a8fd8ee6fe30bb48c692dcbd2fc27", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It so happened that this chair was opposite a narrow passage, which ended in the little circular room where I had seen Uriah Heep’s pale face looking out of the window. Uriah, having taken the pony to a neighbouring stable, was at work at a desk in this room, which had a brass frame on the top to hang paper upon, and on which the writing he was making a copy of was then hanging. Though his face was towards me, I thought, for some time, the writing being between us, that he could not see me; but looking that way more attentively, it made me uncomfortable to observe that, every now and then, his sleepless eyes would come below the writing, like two red suns, and stealthily stare at me for I dare say a whole minute at a time, during which his pen went, or pretended to go, as cleverly as ever. I made several attempts to get out of their way—such as standing on a chair to look at a map on the other side of the room, and poring over the columns of a Kentish newspaper—but they always attracted me back again; and whenever I looked towards those two red suns, I was sure to find them, either just rising or just setting.", "sha256": "16e9072333fae498d1c51d8fb24f75a7bb4308011ce548d87f7c2085b79f70e6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "At length, much to my relief, my aunt and Mr. Wickfield came back, after a pretty long absence. They were not so successful as I could have wished; for though the advantages of the school were undeniable, my aunt had not approved of any of the boarding-houses proposed for me.", "sha256": "1c2a346257b9a564521a0ba49eafd314c0529165dbb1a0aed96428c97718a18a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s very unfortunate,’ said my aunt. ‘I don’t know what to do, Trot.’", "sha256": "08f996491cf6151704a880e0bfe2609e1a47de99bd28f2a6fd5549d9be99290b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It does happen unfortunately,’ said Mr. Wickfield. ‘But I’ll tell you what you can do, Miss Trotwood.’", "sha256": "aae73fbbdb9802ed12360ed52390f76e56b04ce1952e8cd7cc02aeed1e33dfd6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What’s that?’ inquired my aunt.", "sha256": "cf62bffb5744f180887d81a47e5fa8a57c47f20ad66074490904c304eb9db064", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Leave your nephew here, for the present. He’s a quiet fellow. He won’t disturb me at all. It’s a capital house for study. As quiet as a monastery, and almost as roomy. Leave him here.’", "sha256": "2c79761540cca1529197147e669be67ba32046f3c3e46ecb50f6c8f2d6d79442", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt evidently liked the offer, though she was delicate of accepting it. So did I. ‘Come, Miss Trotwood,’ said Mr. Wickfield. ‘This is the way out of the difficulty. It’s only a temporary arrangement, you know. If it don’t act well, or don’t quite accord with our mutual convenience, he can easily go to the right-about. There will be time to find some better place for him in the meanwhile. You had better determine to leave him here for the present!’", "sha256": "90fd86c28bc18ac47606c3daf863676bc906ff1624673febbc8e6b059a59b20d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am very much obliged to you,’ said my aunt; ‘and so is he, I see; but—’", "sha256": "125a2d9f1a58ff119dba25ae3b1cbb68ca2502ded7cba03eacd972524aa1fdf0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Come! I know what you mean,’ cried Mr. Wickfield. ‘You shall not be oppressed by the receipt of favours, Miss Trotwood. You may pay for him, if you like. We won’t be hard about terms, but you shall pay if you will.’", "sha256": "ab5964f6f42e48a9304ff0581423591bfb840fdc6ea43c0a35525627457c0fd1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘On that understanding,’ said my aunt, ‘though it doesn’t lessen the real obligation, I shall be very glad to leave him.’", "sha256": "6cb7a61f7a6b5648075707cbeeade862395d1db5eeaf2cdf81276b25ad38bae0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then come and see my little housekeeper,’ said Mr. Wickfield.", "sha256": "af5f40a8ca128d9a8bb3eeccf9150cc92a6f92d91682d32ac964cbddeed0489b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We accordingly went up a wonderful old staircase; with a balustrade so broad that we might have gone up that, almost as easily; and into a shady old drawing-room, lighted by some three or four of the quaint windows I had looked up at from the street: which had old oak seats in them, that seemed to have come of the same trees as the shining oak floor, and the great beams in the ceiling. It was a prettily furnished room, with a piano and some lively furniture in red and green, and some flowers. It seemed to be all old nooks and corners; and in every nook and corner there was some queer little table, or cupboard, or bookcase, or seat, or something or other, that made me think there was not such another good corner in the room; until I looked at the next one, and found it equal to it, if not better. On everything there was the same air of retirement and cleanliness that marked the house outside.", "sha256": "9c55b85f02a1febb359d3da7511a54f9967845e576d171ad6c1451ed773e3f2e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Wickfield tapped at a door in a corner of the panelled wall, and a girl of about my own age came quickly out and kissed him. On her face, I saw immediately the placid and sweet expression of the lady whose picture had looked at me downstairs. It seemed to my imagination as if the portrait had grown womanly, and the original remained a child. Although her face was quite bright and happy, there was a tranquillity about it, and about her—a quiet, good, calm spirit—that I never have forgotten; that I shall never forget. This was his little housekeeper, his daughter Agnes, Mr. Wickfield said. When I heard how he said it, and saw how he held her hand, I guessed what the one motive of his life was.", "sha256": "c2bad1032feff224444b5275f7e5df706e95008320c772bbd0b6181a1d12d731", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She had a little basket-trifle hanging at her side, with keys in it; and she looked as staid and as discreet a housekeeper as the old house could have. She listened to her father as he told her about me, with a pleasant face; and when he had concluded, proposed to my aunt that we should go upstairs and see my room. We all went together, she before us: and a glorious old room it was, with more oak beams, and diamond panes; and the broad balustrade going all the way up to it.", "sha256": "fcf1f7c636aa6ba793fc5a7ea60a25f4fdd0b4abdc932b7e2244512efd03d369", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I cannot call to mind where or when, in my childhood, I had seen a stained glass window in a church. Nor do I recollect its subject. But I know that when I saw her turn round, in the grave light of the old staircase, and wait for us, above, I thought of that window; and I associated something of its tranquil brightness with Agnes Wickfield ever afterwards.", "sha256": "d70ccff51786de96fada758178538d2345ac642b36002631a0d7e38fdfe6cf93", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt was as happy as I was, in the arrangement made for me; and we went down to the drawing-room again, well pleased and gratified. As she would not hear of staying to dinner, lest she should by any chance fail to arrive at home with the grey pony before dark; and as I apprehend Mr. Wickfield knew her too well to argue any point with her; some lunch was provided for her there, and Agnes went back to her governess, and Mr. Wickfield to his office. So we were left to take leave of one another without any restraint.", "sha256": "73db38f2da42f641eeb06d39646aedb4451be4513166bb09f78ee766a0ba0f5d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She told me that everything would be arranged for me by Mr. Wickfield, and that I should want for nothing, and gave me the kindest words and the best advice.", "sha256": "45493a6f22f80baca2c43a2ff3829a1a6dd4bc7086aeacd69f1e7fccaa549c1a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u017-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Trot,’ said my aunt in conclusion, ‘be a credit to yourself, to me, and Mr. Dick, and Heaven be with you!’", "sha256": "b22075d1e96f8ec5881a018a33cbcbcda66cbd24d1e369ca536a84a79a12566d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[22]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
